samplingFinding: Twenty-seven of forty unseen query pages on twenty previously qualified training domains produced full-page captures. Twelve attempts ended in bounded navigation or capture errors and one was blocked because annotation evidence was unavailable. Manual inspection, minimum-root validation, and frozen evidence validation rejected four successful captures. The accepted set is twenty-three of forty pages and 268 frozen roots, a 57.5% strict yield.
visualValidationFinding: All twenty-seven successful full-page annotation views were inspected at original resolution. Twenty-three pages and 268 frozen roots were accepted across mass, volume, count, length, and area. The accepted evidence includes per-pound, per-ounce, per-square-foot, per-sheet, per-box, per-case, per-yard, per-half-metre, per-metre, fluid-ounce, gallon, quart, package-count, sale-price, price-range, query-adjacent product, and deliberate abstention expressions. Vitality Medical syringes was rejected because it produced only three frozen roots. Obsessed Garage car wash soap was rejected because fixed shipping and contact controls covered selected product-title evidence. Tile and Mosaic Depot hexagon tile was rejected because a fixed accessibility control covered selected price evidence. Food Service Direct beans was rejected because a fixed help control covered selected product-title evidence. Other fixed controls on accepted pages do not cover selected textual title, price, quantity, or native unit-price evidence.
